$comment: RESEARCH CANDIDATE. Not implemented, not validated against, not referenced by any manufacturing stage. This is a shape proposal for how a future governed Relationship Type version might declare its significance transfer semantics, recorded so that the seam is designed rather than improvised when 17th2nd/ASA#29 closes. Providers must never invent transfer modes; the vocabulary is closed here precisely so that a model cannot extend it dynamically. Nothing in this file creates ASA authority or Foundry behaviour.
title: Relationship Type Significance Transfer Signature (Candidate)

candidateStatus.$comment: Present and constant so that no consumer can mistake this record for a ratified contract.

roleTransfer.$comment: Transfer is declared per role, not per relationship. The same relationship transfers differently in each direction: what a container emits toward a member is not what the member emits toward the container. A single relationship-level mode would force those to be equal.

mode.$comment: Closed vocabulary. A provider or model may not extend it: dynamically invented transfer modes would let a model define how significance propagates, which is a governance decision.
